title: 线性时间上下文压缩：基于状态空间编码的Boa压缩器
summary: 提出Boa压缩器，基于Mamba状态空间模型，单次线性时间编码任意长度上下文，通过蒸馏训练匹配完整上下文下的LLM输出分布。压缩比相同时性能媲美或超越离线压缩基线，速度提升一个数量级，支持16倍压缩，可在线逐查询运行。
summary_en: Proposes Boa Compressor, a plug-and-play online context compressor built on a Mamba state-space model that encodes arbitrary-length context in a single linear-time pass. Trained via distillation to match the target LLM's next-token distribution, it matches or surpasses offline compression baselines at equal ratios while being an order of magnitude faster, scaling to 16x compression and enabling per-query online compression.
